name: Dino Trail
comment: Chapter 2's theme (chapters/kafli2.js theme). bpm and beatOffset measured on the loop file with tools/theme-tempo.mjs --theme kafli2 (steady from 28 s to 138 s; from 143 s on the song plays about 120 ms late). Its notes are E-flat major's (E-flat Ionian = B-flat Mixolydian). Key: B-flat major pentatonic at A4 = 441.04 Hz (+4.1 cents), root first (B-flat4 C5 D5 F5 G5), as theme-tempo.mjs bellNotes writes a key: every sound treats key[0] as do. The owner picks B-flat or E-flat as do by ear (qa/remake/kafli2/music/key.html); E-flat would be [623.73, 700.11, 785.85, 934.54, 1048.98]. danceBeats 2: the forest sways and the flowers nod on every second beat (66.7 a minute); the effects and the beat grid keep the song's tempo.
